{{Quote|With both Rhosk and Hss'kas gone Warden Tosk is sure to know something is up. Now is our chance to finish it. Lord Cyssc sits secure in his Citadel, but there will be a way to rouse him. To call for aid would be a sign of weakness for Tosk, one he will not show. But Cyssc would be most pleased to answer such a call.|Gursan Bryes|<ref name="ROTW" />}}
'''Hss'kas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] Broodmaster of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Gursan Bryes]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Broodmaster Hss'kas. To that end, the spacer located a [[VT-49 Decimator/Legends|VT-49 Decimator]] crewed by Hss'kas in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], alongside an escort of four [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]]s. Hss'kas was successfully defeated, but managed to use an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] which reached the surface of Kashyyyk in the region of [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy]]. Bryes requested that the spacer go to Etyyy to kill Hss'kas once and for all.<ref name="ROTW" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hss'kas was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the [[2005]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="ROTW" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
